src: red 4x4 sprite masks s in the 3-by-2 array
dst: red sprite mask d in the same array
match_cond: two distinct s masks have pixelwise union equal to d, and each contributes at least one pixel
transform: recolor the two matched operand sprites teal and d green; leave all other pixels unchanged
multi_step: if duplicate operand copies make the same relation, use the row-major earliest copy
